motivation: Avoid adding large initialized arrays to a self-source that is already capacity-sensitive. Prefer repacking or reusing the bounded physical banks already present in Stage1.

instruction_storage_candidate.physical_storage: reuse ir_ast_event_records_0..3 after compacted structural parsing/lowering
instruction_storage_candidate.conversion_rule: one compacted structural event slot is rewritten in place into at most one verified IR-v2 instruction slot; no expansion is allowed in this storage mode
instruction_storage_candidate.reason: The current implementation already sets ir_instruction_count = ir_ast_event_count after structural/control lowering. Reusing the same slot preserves bounded cardinality and avoids four new 365-entry arrays.
instruction_storage_candidate.required_gate: Native candidate must prove event/instruction one-to-one mapping for every opcode shape before in-place conversion is promoted.
instruction_storage_candidate.rename_policy: Physical array names may remain bootstrap-specific until reproducibility certification; names do not define semantics.

instruction_record_encoding.important_constraint: aux is an ID/payload reference, not an arbitrary raw i64 literal or source byte offset. Large literal payload storage requires its own verified representation.

call_linkage_without_new_large_array.callee_and_args: existing call tables and 746-entry call-argument pool
call_linkage_without_new_large_array.instruction_link: IR-v2 call instruction carries the call_id in an operand/aux ID field

unresolved_before_implementation: Large raw i64 literal payloads cannot be blindly folded into the instruction mixed-radix record.
Current structural ir_value_count counts source numeric values rather than a final semantic def/use namespace.
Array initializer literals must be audited/compacted before selecting the final literal payload representation.

array_initializer_compaction_candidate.idea: Represent repeated zero-filled fixed-array initializers as aggregate zero-init metadata rather than one semantic value per zero token.
array_initializer_compaction_candidate.rule: Do not claim any value headroom from this idea until a static source audit and native Stage1 candidate measurement agree.
array_initializer_compaction_candidate.non_zero_initializers: must remain semantically explicit or use a separately verified aggregate representation

no_new_large_array_rule.exception: A new large array requires measured native evidence that existing banks cannot represent the required semantic lane and a bounded capacity rationale.
